title: It is a Kit: assembly required.
text:
It is a Kit: assembly required.. It wasn't what i expected. It's a kit and you have to put it together. There are no instructions, but there is a sticker on the front of the box that tells you what should be in the box (parts to the kit). At first I thought I was missing parts, but now I realize the picture and pictures of the parts is of another kit (not the one i got)
i received gray coaster that look like snowflakes (as seen in the pic), but then I also received 2 sets of antlers. In the video on Amazon, it show the assembly as having ears, but mine didn't come with that part (didn't have the hole for it either). It never shows the back side, so maybe nothing goes there. The wooden pegs they have for legs should be tapered at the end to aid in assembly, but it wasn't, so there was some difficulty putting the legs in so they would stay in. Also, the distance between the front and back legs is a bit too small to house the coasters when not in use. It looks cute in the picture, but there's plenty of room for improvement. If you didn't have to finesse it so much it probably would be fine, but because of the short distance between the legs, you have to remove the legs and squish the coasters together and far back to put the coasters back in and i inadvertently broke the smaller pieces of the snowflake. I'm not going to send it back because it's a Christmas gift for a family member, i was going to glue the legs in so they wouldn't be falling out, but because you have to take them out to put all the coasters back in, i'll just push them in and finesse it to be presentable and useable without falling apart and gift it assembled. I don't know how well they'll be as coasters, but it's felt so i think it should absorb to protect your table.
